ns2:course.label: Systems Toxicology
ns2:course.description: Provides an overview of the effects of chemicals and their mechanisms of action in a variety of organ systems. Topics include toxicology of the nervous, developmental, reproductive, thyroid, renal, hepatic, immune, pulmonary, and gastrointestinal systems. Prerequisite: Completion of a course in basic toxicology or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Completion of a course in basic toxicology or consent of instructor.
